QuestInfo.name: [Cygnus Knights] The Agony of 10 Boogies
QuestInfo.0: What happened to 10 Boogies? Did she run into the Black Wings? Ask her and find out.
QuestInfo.1:
Some of the kids in town harassed 10 Boogies and took her things. Go find those kids and get back what they stole.
